page.description: Bodhi Linux 7.0.0 images: Standard, AppPack, HWE and System76, with sizes and publisher SHA-256 files.
page.intro: A lightweight Ubuntu-based desktop built around the Moksha window manager, a continuation of Enlightenment 17. Four images for different hardware and app sets.
pros: Very light desktop, suited to older machines.
Ubuntu LTS base with a small default application set.
Four images: Standard, AppPack, HWE and a System76 build.
Each image has its own published SHA-256 file.
cons: Ubuntu base, but the project's support window is shorter than Ubuntu's.
Moksha is niche compared with GNOME or KDE.
The release date shown is the SourceForge file date (2023-08-21).
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Bodhi Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image per variant, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The release date shown is the SourceForge file date (2023-08-21); the project site publishes no readable date here.
